description: Find a performer, band, comedian or act in Bay Area by name (words in `query` must all match; case-insensitive) and get their upcoming events, top venues, genres or topics and the platforms that list them. Names come only from public event listings; there are no contact details. Use it for "when is <band> playing" or "who plays at <venue>". Use get_event with an id for one event's full listing.
name: find_performer
title: Find a performer
